title: backlog.py claim judges busy and keeps ledger records from the item files it read before the ledger lock, so a claim another session made while it waited is dropped
goal: cmd_claim reads the item files of the ledger's ids again once it holds the ledger lock, so a claim another session made in the same checkout while this claim waited is either refused as busy or keeps that session's ledger record

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time,pathlib as P
T=os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py");r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
g("init","-q");(r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items"}));(r/"items").mkdir()
it=lambda i,**k:dict({"id":i,"kind":"story","title":"t "+i,"status":"todo","priority":"P3","goal":"g","touches":["x.txt"],"checks":[{"run":["python3","-c","pass"]}]},**k)
for i in ("ST-aaaaaaaa","ST-bbbbbbbb"):(r/"items"/(i+".json")).write_text(json.dumps(it(i),indent=2)+"\n")
g("add","-A");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","i")
led=P.Path(g("rev-parse","--absolute-git-dir"))/"kb-backlog-claims.json";lock=led.with_name(led.name+".lock")
env=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="S1");env.pop("KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG",None)
lock.write_text("");p=s.Popen([sys.executable,T,"--root",str(r),"claim","ST-aaaaaaaa","--by","w1"],stdout=s.PIPE,stderr=s.STDOUT,text=True,env=env);time.sleep(3)
(r/"items"/"ST-bbbbbbbb.json").write_text(json.dumps(it("ST-bbbbbbbb",status="doing",claimed_by="w2"),indent=2)+"\n")
led.write_text(json.dumps({"ST-bbbbbbbb":{"by":"w2","session":"S2"}}));lock.unlink()
out=p.communicate(timeout=60)[0];d=json.loads(led.read_text())
ok=p.returncode!=0 or "ST-bbbbbbbb" in d
print("claim beside a claim of another session made while it waited: exit",p.returncode,"| record of the other session kept:","ST-bbbbbbbb" in d,out[-160:]);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
